heroSubtitle: End-to-end encrypted transfers with simple links. Based in Switzerland, your privacy is our priority.
howSubtitle: Upload, share a link, and download with your password.
uploadText: Select a file and add a password for encryption.
shareText: Share the link yourself, or, if you're signed in, let us email it to your recipient directly.
downloadText: Recipients unlock the file using your password.
privacyText: End-to-end encryption, anonymous sharing, and automatic expiry keep your data private from upload to download.
autoDeletionText: Links expire after your chosen lifetime or download limit.
openSourceText: Our code is public and auditable.
guestTitle: Send as a guest, or unlock more with an account
guestSubtitle: Every transfer is a secure link. An account just gives you more control over it.
guestText: Upload a file, set a password, and get a shareable link in seconds.
accountText: Everything in a guest transfer, plus full control after you hit send.
accountFeatures: View or change the password anytime
ctaText: Send a secure link in seconds and create an account to manage your transfers and notify recipients by email.
